slides.texte_overlay:
habits that will make you
fearless in any room

the honest compliment

give one specific, honest compliment a day to someone's face. people who notice the good in others become the ones everyone is genuinely glad to see walk in.

finishing your sentence

when someone talks over you, finish your sentence calmly before you let them in. holding your ground in small moments is how you stop shrinking in big ones.

recording a short story

record yourself telling a two minute story every week and listen back. you'll find what to fix, and you'll discover you sound far better than you fear.

having something to say

spend 5 minutes a day learning one interesting thing: a strange animal, a lost city, a famous painting. people who always have a story never dread the silence.
slides.texte_sophia:
having something to say

i used to dread silences in conversation. now i spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson in the Sophia app: a strange animal, a lost city. people with a story never dread silence.

slides.texte_overlay:
the call you'd avoid

make one phone call a day that you'd normally put off: a booking, a question, a friend. the dread before the call is always bigger than the call itself.
